messages:
josh_customer: Hey team — we started migrating nightly index jobs to Redwood last night and hit a wall. Around 03:40 UTC we started getting a burst of 429s, and the job retried a bunch then timed out. We're on the free tier trying to move to paid but need a short breathing room. sample error: "rate_limit_exceeded" request_id=rl-9a3bcf

rate-limit-bot: Automatic alert: org=trial-org123 exceeded hourly write tokens (free-tier). Current limit=60 reqs/min. Policy=soft-throttle.

maria_support: Sorry about the hit, @josh_customer. Can you paste the org id and one full failing request header (no secrets) + request_id? Also did you rotate API keys recently?

josh_customer: Org: trial-org123. Request id above (rl-9a3bcf). Here's a redacted curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","inputs":[...],"max_tokens":512}'
```
We push ~120 concurrent requests during the job (split across 6 threads). Yesterday it worked fine until midnight then boom.

ash_oncall: Quick checklist: 1) confirm no billing_hold on the account 2) check if two API keys are being used causing mixed quota buckets 3) look at burst history in console (token consumption graph). @maria_support can you check the admin view?

maria_support: I checked — account shows "billing_pending" flag from an invoice issue last bill cycle. That can cause temporary quota reduction on free-to-paid transition. I'll escalate billing but in the short term we can request a temporary quota bump from Sales.

devon_sales: Hi @josh_customer — we can approve a temporary increase for your migration window. Need: expected peak RPS, start/end times, and a quick validation payment method on file. If you share peak RPS I can fast-path a 48h uplift.

josh_customer: Peak about 100 reqs/sec for 2 hours next Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. We can provide card.

maria_support: Options while sales processes uplift: 1) stagger batches (reduce per-thread concurrency) 2) implement jittered exponential backoff on 429s (we usually recommend 200-500ms base + jitter) 3) use multiple org API keys only if coordinated with Sales (otherwise you risk per-key throttles).

ash_oncall: Also try prefilling KV cache to avoid heavy decoder time for initial tokens — that reduces token cost during bursts. If you can run a short dry-run with a smaller payload we can observe and whitelist pattern.

josh_customer: Will do a dry-run tonight. Also curious — can a billing_hold drop you to free-tier limits even if you had a paid commit queued?

maria_support: Yes, billing flags can force a downgrade to baseline free limits until the invoice is settled. That's why Sales will ask for a validation payment.

devon_sales: I'll open a ticket for a 48h temporary quota increase once you confirm card and exact windows. Also cc'ing @ash_oncall so engineering can monitor.

josh_customer: Thanks. One more datapoint: I saw 401s earlier but they were from a rotated key — fixed that. Right now the failing ones are 429s only.

maria_support: Perfect. Please paste the dry-run request_id when you run it and I'll watch the logs. If we see repeated 429 patterns we can convert to a short-lived exception token for your migration (won't change billing flags).

ash_oncall: FYI I'll enable verbose logging for trial-org123 for the next 6 hours so we can capture traces. If you hit it again, keep screenshots of the top-level error and request_id.

josh_customer: Got it, running dry-run at 22:30 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_support: Thanks — I'll stitch this into a support ticket and CC Sales to expedite.

devon_sales: Quick ask for the checkout: org billing email + last 4 of card once you PM us. We'll aim to have uplift in <4 hours after receipt.

josh_customer: PMing details now.

rate-limit-bot: Note: manual exceptions must be within policy. Any permanent capacity beyond reserved tiers requires Dedicated or Paid commit.

maria_support: Closing loop — created support ticket #SUP-8742 and flagged for immediate Sales uplift + Oncall monitoring. Keep replies here for updates.
